topic: How GoMining rewards and maintenance charges work
hook: Daily Bitcoin rewards sound simple. Here's the part people skip.

scenes.narration: Per a third-party explainer, owners are credited bitcoin rewards each day.
A maintenance charge covering electricity and service costs is deducted from those rewards.
Bitcoin's price and network difficulty change, so the net result can be low or even negative. And digital miners can't be redeemed for bitcoin.

cta: Learn more about GoMining through the link on my channel page. It's a referral link, so I may earn a benefit.
